## Change and motivation

What project question or failure does this address?

## Evidence

State the exact commands and results. Synthetic tests, real account probes and
repeated production execution are different evidence levels.

## Review checklist

- [ ] No credentials, private databases, reports, query terms or raw provider responses are committed.
- [ ] Metric scope, period, timezone, coverage and quality remain explicit.
- [ ] Failed or incomplete collection leaves the previous published history intact.
- [ ] New behavior has a regression fixture and CLI/API documentation where applicable.
- [ ] `npm run check`, `npm run test:d1`, `npm run worker:check` and browser checks pass.
- [ ] Deployment, billing, account grants and publication are not implied by merging code.
